problem: Recurring Taiwan e-commerce back-office operations for small brands
user: Taiwan microbrand owner, e-commerce operator or small operations team
economic_buyer: Brand owner or e-commerce operations lead

evidence_items.claim_supported: Page contains customer reviews describing completed e-commerce outsourcing outcomes; platform describes contract and third-party payment flow and TOP PRO criteria requiring completed transactions and customer reviews.
evidence_items.independence: Taiwan marketplace category with completed-review context
evidence_items.limitations: broad category; does not verify payment for the narrow fixed bundle

evidence_items.claim_supported: Buyer requests long-term support for listings, customer complaints, payment/logistics coordination, inventory and operations; another request proposes monthly fee plus performance share.
evidence_items.limitations: posted requests are not proof of accepted or paid work

evidence_items.claim_supported: Paid roles include platform listing, product maintenance, inventory, orders, returns, customer service and sales-data tracking; visible salary ranges include NT$35,000–55,000/month for some roles.
evidence_items.limitations: internal hiring does not prove external vendor demand

willingness_to_pay_evidence: paid_transaction for broad category; exact narrow package remains unproven

recurrence_and_leverage.recurrence_trigger: daily/weekly platform operations, campaign cycles, orders, returns and inventory exceptions
recurrence_and_leverage.standardizable_unit: one platform, fixed SKU/order band, response SLA, listing/update checklist and exception queue
recurrence_and_leverage.leverage_path: SOPs, batch operations, templates, trained operators and selective automation

contradictory_evidence: performance/creative work may dominate buyer expectations
quality control may scale with order volume
